title: Employee Creator
description: A React and TypeScript app for browsing and managing employees, with search, employee detail pages and an AI chat assistant. Data fetching and caching are handled with TanStack Query, forms with React Hook Form and Zod validation, and UI components are built with Tailwind CSS and documented and tested in Storybook. It's backed by an Express and MongoDB REST API.

title: Ecommerce Store
description: A full-stack online shop with a Vue.js and TypeScript frontend for browsing products with stock availability. The backend is an Express REST API where users can register and log in with JWT authentication, browse products and categories, and add items to a cart with stock checks. Request validation is done with Zod, the API is documented with Swagger, and it's covered by unit and integration tests run in CI.

title: Wedding RSVP
description: A bilingual (English and Polish) wedding RSVP app with a serverless AWS backend. Guests log in with an invitation code to see wedding day details and submit their RSVP and dietary requirements, with JWT authentication stored in an HTTP-only cookie.
